notes: SPOTLIGHT SOLO v2 SNAPBACK (No.10, back view, full body; shot 2 crops it at the waist). Back view, never mirrored (no west strip); his right = screen-right. Registration = Stand Back: body centre x 64, soles on row 102. contact = the outer (screen-left) sole pixel (48,102) of the planted LEFT boot, which keeps the Stand Back a pixels on all four frames (soleRun = its row-102 run, plantSole = its centre); the RIGHT sole (76,89) is on the ball beyond his right foot. ball = the ball guide (78,95), never drawn, ballUnder (drawn before the sprite). The snap arm is his RIGHT arm (screen-right): elbow, wrist, hand (palm centre), tip (the highest fingertip); SB2 knot = the pinch (thumb tip on the middle fingertip: the crash-zoom target); SB3 gap = the 3 px notch between the flicked thumb (thumbTip) and the index (the snap spark and the light rain; deliberately empty pixels). Points are pixel indices (studioAnim adds 0.5). Strip order = studio frame order SB1 SB2 SB3 SB0 (SB0 was appended as studio frame 4); PLAY ORDER is SB0 SB1 SB2 SB3. Shot 2 (x3.4): SB0 0.95-1.10, SB1 1.10-1.30, SB2 1.30-1.60 (crash zoom on the hand 1.40-1.55), SB3 1.60-1.80 (the snap), SB3 again 2.40-2.80 as the rimmed silhouette / longShadow source. Studio: Sochetra / SnapBack / Back, layer Art (Front/Side blank).
